explication: INTERCEPT is a web-based signal-intelligence platform: users select a monitoring mode, the server controls or receives data from radio and network sensors, and the interface presents decoded messages, tracks, alerts, and analysis. The map captures the major documented capabilities and shared event handling. Several feature implementations are represented by their enclosing directories because their source was not sampled; those links are limited to documented behavior.
